description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of Git's '@{push}' syntax in various configurations. It sets up Git repositories, configures push options, and verifies the resolution of the '@{push}' refspec under different scenarios.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Function to resolve a refspec like 'main@{push}' and compare it against an expected value, used to verify proper resolution of '@{push}' in different configurations.
